pyJianYingDraft 0.3.0 project-proven source snapshot.
Upstream: https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyJianYingDraft
License: Apache-2.0; full license in pyJianYingDraft-LICENSE.txt.
This distribution preserves the project-tested native writer, MediaInfo coercion and track API.
Packaging change: removed the eager Windows JianyingController import/export from __init__.py. Native JSON authoring does not load or use GUI automation.
Bytecode caches, environments, credentials and personal media are excluded.
